rules.profile: Use a disposable, dedicated Hermes profile/HERMES_HOME with no concurrent work. Never run synthetic failure fixtures against a production profile.
rules.correlation: Generate one UUID correlation_id per run and carry it in the job name, script fixture marker, evidence bundle, disposable provider log, and delivery-sink log. Use one dedicated fixture HERMES_HOME and one bounded before/after window.
rules.window: Capture supported Hermes CLI and external boundary evidence immediately before the run, execute exactly once, wait for terminal cron history plus provider/delivery settlement, then capture immediately after. Record UTC timestamps and settle_seconds.
rules.cleanup: Delete only the disposable fixture job/profile state after evidence is copied. Do not mutate production jobs, credentials, chats, Kanban, Forgejo, ntfy, Prometheus, or application state.
rules.failure: Failed, malformed, timed-out, killed, restarted, missing, ambiguous, or uncorrelated evidence is never green.

scheduler_executions.correlation: exact job_id plus execution id in one dedicated fixture HERMES_HOME
scheduler_executions.purpose: one scheduler execution and terminal status

agent_sessions_and_tokens.owner: Hermes sessions public CLI plus disposable provider boundary
agent_sessions_and_tokens.correlation: dedicated fixture HERMES_HOME plus exact provider job_id and correlation_id
agent_sessions_and_tokens.purpose: session creation and physical model usage without private Hermes database access
agent_sessions_and_tokens.derivation: agent_sessions is the before/after set difference of public cron-session IDs; input_tokens and output_tokens are summed from new provider events

model_attempts.owner: Disposable local OpenAI-compatible provider used only by the controlled fixture profile
model_attempts.path: operator-selected append-only JSONL passed to collect.py --model-log
model_attempts.event_schema: exactly event_id, correlation_id, job_id, received_at, completed_at, outcome, input_tokens, output_tokens; outcome is success, error, or interrupted
model_attempts.derivation: model_attempts counts new events; model_successes counts success outcomes; token observations sum new event usage. Interrupted events have no completed_at and remain attempts.
model_attempts.correlation: exact job_id and correlation_id recorded by the provider fixture
model_attempts.purpose: observe physical API attempts, terminal provider outcomes, and response usage without private Hermes metrics tables

delivery.owner: Disposable local delivery sink for the controlled fixture profile
delivery.path: operator-selected append-only JSONL passed to collect.py --delivery-log
delivery.event_schema: exactly event_id, correlation_id, job_id, received_at; all non-empty strings
delivery.derivation: deliveries is the count of new event_id values whose correlation_id and job_id exactly match the run
delivery.correlation: exact job_id and correlation_id recorded by the sink
delivery.purpose: observe real delivery requests without relying on gateway log verbosity or claiming human receipt

external_mutation.correlation: same before/after window and named probe
external_mutation.purpose: prove no Kanban, Forgejo, ntfy, Prometheus, or other configured external mutation on healthy no-change

fixtures.name: healthy_no_change
fixtures.expected: one successful execution; zero changed events, sessions, model attempts/successes, tokens, deliveries, and external mutations

fixtures.name: real_change_positive_control
fixtures.input: valid gate output {"wakeAgent":true,"context":{...}} with a deterministic local fixture
fixtures.expected: one successful execution and at least one session, logical model attempt, successful call, non-zero token usage, and one correlated request at the disposable delivery sink

fixtures.name: gate_error_fail_safe
fixtures.input: valid wakeAgent=true error context produced by the gate's supported force-error knob
fixtures.expected: agent wakes and the error path is visible; never synthetic production breakage

fixtures.name: malformed_gate_fail_closed
fixtures.input: malformed/non-JSON gate output in the disposable profile
fixtures.expected: native fail-safe wake, one agent/model path, and a visible terminal execution; never silently classified as no change

fixtures.name: timeout_fail_closed
fixtures.input: bounded gate script exceeding its disposable script timeout
fixtures.expected: native script-error prompt wakes the agent and reports the timeout; never silently classified as no change

fixtures.name: kill_restart_fail_closed
fixtures.input: kill/restart only the disposable fixture gateway during a controlled run
fixtures.expected: failed/incomplete with visible error; never success
